gt_policy: Known ten detection classes, lidar+radar points >0, class-centre range (50m vehicles,40m pedestrian/bicycle/motorcycle,30m barrier/cone). No bike-rack exclusion: unavailable. Use stored LiDAR-frame centre/length/width/height/yaw transformed by lidar2ego.
prediction_policy: Global quaternion boxes transformed by inverse ego2global; same class-centre range; score >= threshold. No bike-rack exclusion.
geometry: Convex hull of all eight transformed corners projected to ego XY; touching intersects. Robot centred on ego origin. No vertical filter, motion or stopping model.
outcome: At least one box intersects corridor; compare predicted alert to annotation-derived alert. Report missed alerts among positive frames and unreferenced alerts among negative frames. Annotation-negative is not verified free space.
uncertainty: 2000 paired scene bootstrap resamples, seed 20261023; resample 150 scenes with replacement preserving four frames and both models. Percentile 95% intervals. Sampling variation only, conditional on frozen frames and annotations. Undefined ratios excluded and counted.
figures: One composite. No post-result corridor tuning or frame selection for headline analysis.
scope: Offline annotation-based diagnostic; not exact SDK replay, robot navigation, safety certification or factory validation. Full quaternion GT and bike-rack metadata unavailable. Six-case pilot is not pooled.
